verdict.rationale: Ramp's own product page directly claims this exact capability: 'AI-powered intake parses contracts and screenshots to auto-populate request forms.' Related evidence shows procurement request approval routing across finance, IT, legal and security, and unified procurement requests, which places the forms in a real intake workflow. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on which contract fields are extracted and how the forms are populated, accuracy or limitation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond a single marketing line.
